summary: Elemental Royalty Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 14, 2026, announcing its addition to the MVIS Global Junior Gold Miners Index, the benchmark for the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ), effective after market close on Friday, September 18, 2026, under GDXJ's semi-annual review and quarterly rebalance. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing condition is stated. GDXJ holds roughly US$9.3 billion in net assets as of September 11, 2026. Watch index-fund flows around the September 18 effective date.
